responsibility: Implements the RTL basic-block layout optimization passes that reorder blocks for better fallthrough and branch behavior, partition blocks into hot and cold sections, and duplicate indirect-jump blocks for computed-goto handling. It contains the trace-construction and connection heuristics for speed- and size-oriented block ordering, target-sensitive handling of crossing edges between hot/cold partitions, and the RTL pass hooks such as `pass_partition_blocks` that rewrite CFG layout, create bridging jumps when section boundaries require them, and update dataflow state after these structural transformations.
same_name_distinction: Provides the RTL implementation of block reordering and hot/cold partitioning passes, including trace construction, CFG rewrites, and target-dependent crossing-edge fixups; unlike gcc/bb-reorder.h, it contains the executable algorithms and pass definitions rather than just the small target interface they use.
